outputs.Decision_and_explanation: FAIL: Top plot in panel C is a box-and-whisker plot showing total polyp number per mouse across genotypes, but the caption only gives sample size and significance stars (n=8-18 per genotype; *P<0.05; ***P<0.001) without stating what the box, median line, or whiskers represent (e.g., IQR, min-max, percentiles).
FAIL: The bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 shows an error bar, but the caption does not state what it represents (no SD, SEM, or replicate/n information given).
FAIL: The 'Relative expression' bar chart (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shows error bars, but the caption does not define what they represent (no SD, SEM, or n stated).
